label: Introduction
subgoals: Write sec(x) as 1/cos(x) wherever cosine is nonzero
Mark vertical asymptotes at pi/2 + k*pi from the cosine zeros

label: Properties
subgoals: Exclude pi/2 + k*pi from the domain of the secant
Apply evenness sec(-x) = sec(x) to mirror branches
Take the least positive value sec(0) = 1 at the origin

label: Limits, derivatives, and integrals of the secant function
section: Limits, derivatives, and integrals of the secant function
subgoals: Link secant to tangent with sec^2(x) = 1 + tan^2(x)
Differentiate sec(x) to sec(x)*tan(x) on its domain
Integrate sec(x) to ln|sec(x) + tan(x)| + c
